risks.risk: Grill function may not work (or may be missing/weak), even if microwave works.
risks.proof: A short video of the grill mode running (or a photo showing grill indicator + a timed heating test).
risks.if_unproven: Price as microwave-only / not guaranteed grill.

risks.risk: Microwave may not heat properly (weak magnetron) or may have intermittent faults.
risks.proof: A heating test video: place a cup of water, run for 1–2 minutes, show thermometer/steam and the display time counting down.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not fully proven working (worst case: treat as needing testing).

risks.risk: Capacity/size (e.g., 20L vs 23L) is unclear from the photo, affecting value.
risks.proof: Photo of the rating plate/label showing capacity (liters) and model number.
risks.if_unproven: Price at the lower-capacity end comparable (worst case vs higher-capacity units).

risks.risk: Turntable/rollers may be faulty or missing.
risks.proof: Photo of the turntable plate and rollers underneath (and confirm it rotates during a test).
risks.if_unproven: Price as if turntable/rotation may be an issue.

proof_requests: Photo of the rating plate/label (model number + capacity in liters).
Short video showing microwave heating test (water heats) with the display running.
Short video showing grill mode working (or clear photo of grill indicator + heating result).
Photo of turntable plate/rollers and confirmation it rotates during the test.
Photos of the receipt and warranty card (if available).
response.reason: The photo shows a countertop microwave, but grill capability and full working condition are not provable from the single image. I will price it using the closest microwave comparables at the worst case (treat as microwave-only / not fully proven).
